senses.gloss:
हठ् {c1c} P. (हठति)
1 To leap,
jump.
--2 To be wicked.
--3 To
oppress.
--4 To bind to a post.

1 Violence, force.
--2
Oppression, rapine. हठेन and हठात्
are used adverbially in the sense of
‘forcibly’, ‘violently’, ‘suddenly,
‘against one's will’; अंबालिका च
चंडवर्मणा हठात् परिणेतुमात्मभवनमनीयत
Dk.; वानरान् वारयामास हठेन मधुरेण
च Rām.
--Comp.
--योगः a
particular mode of Yoga or practising
abstract meditation, (so called, as
distinguished from राजयोग q. v.,
because it is very difficult to practise;
it may be performed in various
ways, such as by standing on one
leg, holding up the arms, inhaling
smoke with the head inverted &c.).
--विद्या the science of forced
meditation.
